basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old graphic designer based in Toronto who recently embarked on a hair regrowth journey after noticing early signs of thinning. I'm passionate about digital art and have been exploring different software like xLights and Gaomon tablets. My interests also include urban exploration and music, especially anything related to Davie504. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work or during weekends. Currently single, I enjoy spending my free time learning new skills and participating in local art communities.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Graphic Design and have been working in the field for the last 4 years. My interest in technology and art is largely self-taught, supplemented by online courses and tutorials. I also have a growing interest in healthcare and personal wellness, which I've been learning about through online forums and communities.
